title: My Game Iron Oath: Doctor Simulator FREE through November 16
author: Goynucek
selftext:
Would you protect a patient if it put your own family at risk?

I’m the developer of Iron Oath, a story-driven doctor simulator set under an authoritarian government.

Examine patients, manage scarce medicine, and face choices between state orders, your conscience, and your family’s survival. Your decisions lead to 8 different endings across a 30-day campaign.

The full game is free on the **US App Store through November 16**, returning to $0.99 on November 17. No ads or in-app purchases.

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6822442822](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6822442822)

Happy to answer questions about the game!
